text: It's good for socialization, but the paywall is thick. I've spent some money, but no more. the $25 monthly pass should be lowered to $10... I know they'd sell 10X as many... The vehicle mods are locked so tight, if you don't spend hundreds, you won't advance... They don't care though, and probably don't read reviews, but if they do... Lower the prices...

Kind of fun until level 7, then you start to run low on resources. Choices are buy more or go out your city to mine. Fine, until a much more powerful player kills you and takes all your resources that you've spent hours mining. Instant uninstall. I want to enjoy myself, not get angry and frustrated, or play a game trying to force you to spend money. This is a bait and switch. I came here to do the run/shoot zombies, not to build a base or have much stronger players wipe out hours of work.

It's not a zombie shooter, you do that a tad in the beginning and then it's a side activity which ends quickly. This is more of an idle city building war game. Pay to play (obviously) but you can still enjoy it without spending money. This does add on time required to do stuff but still doable. You do hit the point where things start taking days to upgrade so it hits a dragging spot but they are generous with speed ups, bonus events for extra supplies and equipment.

The game starts out just like the ads but quickly turns into a grindy hero shooter runner. The main gameplay is as a city building game, which adds to the grindyness. Also, the main plot is basically a harem dating sim. If that's what you want, sure, go for it. TLDR: Not really like the ads after you play for a while.

so I really like this game for 90% of it. what i dont like or understand is part of the stages where there is a Face off. the majority of challenges involve skill and quick problem solving. but I have been stuck for a week now, at a face-off stage only requiring 255,000k. I have done side quests and challenges for a week to build my strength from 230,000 to 265, 270k . still the game will not let me move past the next. challenge, even though I have spent plenty of time and money on it.

I started playing this game about an hour ago and honestly it's entertaining, but within this hour the game rebooted 4 times. It rebooted 2 additional times trying to get my account linked. On top of that the controls are very slow and lag. I find myself double tapping often because it feels like it's not accepting the input. Not fun when you're playing a game that's designed nickel and dime you and press something you didn't want to. PS: after posting the game rebooted again. Uninstalling now.

PLAYERS BEWARE!!! This game is NOTHING like the ads show. This a Pay 2 Play mining game where you need ever increasing resources to build and level up your camp. There is a watered down version of the left to right shooter available once a week, that is only 5 short levels. This is just so the devs can say it's not a complete SCAM, but it's not what's in the ads. They also turn the comments off on the ads which should tell you they are trying to hide something. DON'T FALL VICTIM TO THIS SCAM!!!!

It has been more than a month and I still can't login to the game on my primary device. All support has to do is change my email address, that is bound to my account, since the game won't send the verification code required for login to my current email. Support is absolutely pathetic. Also, they keep trying to blame my email for the original problem when jf is 100% the devs fault. The game gives an error message that no verification code was sent. Avoid like the plague.

As other players have mentioned, this could be much more fun and could be a much greater profit generator for the company. BUT they are allowing players to bully weaker players. I am deleting this game instead of investing in it. Solely because I refuse to put what little spare time I get into this game, then have it wiped out in the middle of the night from a repeated attack by another player leaving me with nothing. Developers don't care, they give the same hollow response to everyone! shame!

The developers are getting greedy. I paid for the auto help feature and then was sent a message that the feature was being modified. it sure was modified. You only get a limited amount of auto help. The main reason I paid for it was to get the auto help. I got used to not having to deal with having to tap the help button just in time for the developers to take it partially away. I am sure to make room to have us pay more to get the full feature back. Not cool.

Shady as heck. Made a purchase, immediately got a "device has security risk" pop-up. can't log in, says "abnormality " on loading screen. The only abnormality is taking the $ and immediately locking me out, and then leaving the loading screens stuck on 75% so I can't get in after they get the $. plus, their monthly pass other games charge $5 for? they want $25. for a frame and extra march. That's it. That's more than PS+ or Game Pass Ult w/ HUNDREDS of games. For trivial stuff in 1 game

I am currently on day 555 of playing. The game doesn't keep me going, the people on my team do. The devs find any way the can to squeeze and tick off the players. Get used to playing whales and losing everything. This is a P2W game, NOT for the casual person or F2P. Also, this game IS NOT the same as the ads. It's tower defense with the occasional left right runner. It's mostly about farming resources, building troops, gaining heros, and attacking others. Gets old fast.

So far, so good. It's really addictive, to be honest. lol. Reminds me a little of the walking dead but in gameplay form. it can be quite cost-heavy. I've already spent about $60, and I've only been playing a week. I'm gonna slow down on buying stuff going forward, though. The good thing is that there are free things you can get by building, farming for materials, and upgrading building headquarters. So, you might have to work at it if you plan to be f2p.

I'm in season 2 at this point and I can say this is not a game it's a subscription. There is little to do without the weekly 20 dollar pass. Yes weekly there is no way for free access to any heros after the first 2. And forget the equipment you're never see them. Every 6 months there's a chance if you're in a alliance but that's it. This game is a subscription of 100 dollars to 1000 dollars a month to play and stay improving. Avoid it like the plague god knows I wish I did.

Fun game at the beginning, then just turns into a money grabbing game. Expensive for no more stuff then you get. You spend more time marching and building then actual playing. The hours it takes to upgrade main buildings is REDICULOUS!!! Also, the time digging for resources is REDICULOUS too! You have to join a big clan if you dont want to constantly get hit or zero'd out.

Not sure what happened, as this hadn't happened before, but I bought the offer for $19.99 in gold bars, which would provide 4,200 bars. My bank account was charged, but my account was awarded only 2,100 bars. I tried contacting customer services, but received no answer. Sorry, great game, but, I hate stealing. If this is corrected, I'll change my rating.

Since the last update the game crashes either 10 seconds after it loads or 2 minutes after it loads. It is practically unplayable on my phone now. Even the PC version is starting to lag. Yes I have uninstalled and reinstalled and am currently still trying to get back to my regular account an hour later.

The game starts well enough, and yes the game drifts severely from what it's advertised. That's OK if you want a Sim/nation building game. The problem is the further along you get, the more it's about grinding. It gets tedious and unfortunately you can't play a lot of what you installed the game for. Very repetitive. What's worse is you need fuel to perform these grind tasks and you get little. What is the point of a game you can't do anything in. For all that is holy, ditch the gas aspect.

I dont ever write reviews but I thought that it was warranted. It's like advertised but has some flaws. If you play and build your base don't expect to get above level 17 or 18. You will constantly get attacked by higher level players making it almost impossible to save enough resources to level up. The only way to level up is spend a ton of money to buy the resources or characters.

The end game is a grind and you have to spend money to even compete with other players. free to play players don't stand a chance. a lot of bugs on new and old events. the event times are mostly China ST. they do have some events where you can pick but most of the world events are based on that time. if you do purchase anything you'll have to keep doing so. top players always stay on top. when the game works(lots of bugs) it's fun and if you're in a good alliance.

This is nothing more than a carrot-at-the-end-of-a-stick game where you'll be spending your money chasing goal posts that are constantly moved. This game takes zero skills or strategy. All it takes is money to advance. And I'm not talking about a few hundreds; I'm talking about spending tens of thousands of dollars. For example, to unlock the destroyer Ex, it will cost you $25,000. Who spends $25K on a game? people have lost their damn minds.

I think I've come to the point this game became pointless unless you spend money constantly and I refuse to do it for this type of game. It's now requiring you to have your Shields up every day and they want to charge you $50 a day to maintain those Shields or you don't have any resources and the game's not fun anymore so I think I'm done playing. Other similar games only for the most part have battles only on the weekends so you're able to build during the week.

Fun until you have to update every other week, and you have to clear out a Gb or more of space on your phone every time just to update and continue playing. Also, after a certain point, only occasional games play like the advertised game play, and you get zeroed weekly if you have any kind of social life, so you need to constantly be on your toes. Additionally, there are hackers everywhere, so if you've spent a lot of money, you're at risk of being hacked

One of the worst games I've played. A strong player level 30 can attack a small level 10 player and steal all their resources and nothing you can do, except spend money to defend, and you'll never be able to catch up except spending a ton of $$$$. Developer's money pit, has to be a limit of what level you can attack.

Then all of a sudden your base is on fire and you find out your actually playing a war game, not the zombie shoote

And people will constantly attack you, which I believe are the people who pay to play. I was attacked by the same person like 7 times in a row. The game for me in no longer fun to play at all.

Enjoy playing the game but it's time consuming, which in turns after a while just makes you want to delete the app permanently especially since game is built on players who spend a fortune. Build time after lvl 18 takes forever and trying to hide under shield from big spenders who don't care about your growth and just try to eliminate all your progress. graphics are great, alliance teamwork helps, would be nice to just transfer resources to teammates also.

So much bullying in the game!! it is reported constantly but they refuse to do anything of it since that player spends money (yet almost every player spends money). all they care about is fixing translating bugs 🤦‍♀️ DO NOT RECOMMEND! Game not as advertised. it's a city building gamed turned into a cult-like alliance game of acquiring resources. The caveat is that resources can be purchased. Pay to win is the game, with many players spending tens of thousands of dollars or more. Why subject ourselves to this type of entertainment? Don't walk, run.

The game is good, but after 2 weeks of playing, I've noticed a lot of bugs that seem to put yourself in a disadvantage. I don't know if it's intended, but for example, whenever I battle people in arena, the game switches to my weakest troops without my input, so if you just spam the attack button, you'd later realize your battling with your weakest troops. Also, during Bonus Time, I achieved the reward but nothing was given to me. It kinda feels scammy.

The game is pro-spender... the big spender. It is not just about the in-game purchases. Matches of the servers in the duels are designed to make the players feel 'weak' so you will have the urge to spend more. Algorithms seem rigged & some of the rules (e.g. tp not allowed when the server is under invation or when your hq is under attack) don't make sense. They are designed for you to lose, so you purchase more resources and buffs. You can find better games. Bet the rating is rigged.

The game has always some issues. The chat is always lagging. From the very day I downloaded the game I noticed that problem. They couldn't fix it even after few updates. Issue with heros' avatars. Issue with war when a lot of players gathering the server doesn't function properly. Support in the game not responsive. Even after a few months the support hasn't been responded. Very bad service 😒

Season one was...ok. Season 2 is awful, crazy, silly rules on how things have to be set up. Slogging through the game. It is not fun. Buildings that have no other use than cannon fodder. NO RESEMBLENCE IN ANY PART OF THE GAME TO THE ORIGINAL AD. Caravan, explore. Push a button stand in a line and fire. So unbelievably boring.

Fun to play - until the paywall hits. love the gameplay from combat to base building, but there is a very distinguished plateau for player development for members who do not spend money on the micro transactions. I have found myself spending money when my team is under attack just to try to rapidly accrue resources needed to defend ourselves. definitely seems like the a pay to win game

was great, then they changed the whole app to portrait and now it's hardly playable. they did all that work to fix a minor problem everyone had. chat had wide keyboard layout. all they needed to do was allow it to auto rotate in chat view. problem solved. now there's a ton of bugs, new found every day. you can't zoom out enough to get the width you need and they forced everyone onto portrait mode by giving you extra hard to obtain rewards to try it out without giving you the ability to go back.

Looked interesting at first, but the actual game play is as dull and slow as it's story line. You only have one major control, and that's just moving left or right. Not much else except for a couple of areas you have to tap on. Looked interesting, but that's as far as it goes.

For once, the ads didn't lie. It's gameplay was like what was shown, only thing they DIDN'T say was that your companions for the story part are all excessively, scantily cladded women in the game. 😒 Can't play it on the bus, in that case. Other than that, it's fun.

I've enjoyed playing Last Z and have been active through all four seasons. The game itself is fun and engaging, but the customer support is extremely disappointing. Several tickets I've submitted have not been resolved properly, despite the time and effort I've invested in the game. When players encounter issues, they deserve timely and fair support, not unanswered or unresolved cases. Good game, poor customer service.

⚠️The game is nothing like the screenshots. They're extremely misleading. -🛠️ It's a strategy game, majorly around construction and significantly alliance-dependent. -💲It is pay-to-win: if you don't want to spend a minimum of $30–50/month, you won't enjoy it once it is a bit developed. -⏰ It requires constant (at least once every 6–8 hours) log-ins and boring interactions to keep producing/collecting items. -🐢The progress is EXTREMELY slow; it's like filling a large pool with a cup.

About this game. Game packages are getting more expensive. And the packages you get are not proportional to the price of the game. The price is high, but the game props and resources provided are few. And the game often disconnects. The hero's combat effectiveness is different in every location. I have expressed and complained to the customer service of this game many times. But it's the same, no improvement. Nowadays the game is expensive and the difficulty level has been increased.

Do not download if your in Europe. The developers are useless and the game is shite. After a few hours, the difficulty spikes and progression grinds to a halt unless you’re willing to spend a lot of money. The in-game currency dries up quickly, upgrade costs become outrageous Events are also heavily skewed in favour of paying players, and leaderboards might as well be a list of who spent the most. There’s no balance, no real strategy.

Not a bad game so far. biggest issues is it's not f2p friendly as they make teleports very expensive and hard to get and they dont allow for castle relocation without using teleports. most games like this allow you to move your castle which can take time but not cost instant teleports. this game doesn't do that and forces the use of teleports which they block behind in-game currency or ridiculous high item costs. Makes a war game less fun.

You know that stupid ad game where you move side to side and shoot zombies, well this is that. Kind of. Instead of just creating interesting levels and power ups, they have tacked on a dumb city builder and "story" with stupid AI anime characters, I played this because I wanted a dumb little diversion with a few levels, with some that might take a few attempts. If you give people what they want, you won't have to try so hard to make money.

Overall Great game to play. I strongly suggest not playing this game. I eventually had to quit myself. Dear Support, I would like to complain about the Medical Auto Help limit. The current limit affects both weaker players and highly active players. The switch to the vertical mode totally erased the cool immersion of this game, moreover I don't have such a good overview over the map and events. The horizontal view was just perfect, don't know why you switched the mode. The videos of your heroines, that were almost on artistic level, are no more. Maybe somebody complained that they were "too much" ? I'm quitting this game

This game uses every psychological trick in the book to keep you playing, but never actually challenges you. The mini games are so simple they're boring ('should I choose an increase or decrease in power?') and it keeps telling you what to do, while giving you the illusion you're actually making a choice. The goal, of course, is to get you hooked so you spend money when it stops giving you things for free. But why pay for a game that requires no real strategy or skill? What a waste of time.

Apart from keeping upgrading troops and buildings! There's no actual game you can play! It gets very boring! I was hoping the game would become more interesting but it's actually becoming more boring... collecting stuffs everyday, upgrading and that's about it. There's nothing you can play when you want to! Uninstalling...

Title: Fun at first, but turns into a paywall nightmare At first, I really enjoyed the game — great graphics, fun heroes, and exciting battles. But after a while, it becomes ridiculously hard, no matter how much progress you make. Even if you spend money and get S-Class heroes, the difficulty spikes so fast that you’re basically forced to keep spending just to keep up. The balance feels totally off — it’s less about skill and more about how deep your wallet is. It’s frustrating.

These games advertise epic action—killing zombies, massive monsters. That’s all I want: shoot, kill, level up, and move on. But instead, I’m stuck in a city-building phase for over 10 minutes, trying to move on and play. It’s so frustrating. I just want to kill things, not build cities. If it were faster, like pressing a few buttons to build and move on, fine. But no, I’m stuck pressing things endlessly with no progress. It’s awful.

This game is fun and addictive. Its more like a war game. But upgrading HQ, heroes and tanks is such a pain. The item for upgrades is hard to get. The easy way to get an item for upgrades is to purchase it in the shop. But the price was insane. Too expensive for me compared with other games out there. If you invest lots of money you'll be stronger than anyone fast.

This is not like the ads. I just wanted a simple run and gun game, no bs one level after the other, but this is like many others in the same style, a base/city building with lots of micro transactions with a bit of run and gun, that part is very underwhelming, on the ads it looks more fun. in the beginning everything levels up so fast that you think something is wrong, then as you spend more than 20 minutes playing, it becomes more and more difficult and you need to grind or pay to get some prog

The game is not completely like the ads. Even the bulky guy in the thumbnail isn't part of the game. The arcade shooting and sweeping parts are fun when they are available. After 3 hours it would be impossible to continue without paying and you won't be able to progress with the game without spending hours collecting resources that are so scarce. The 'service' or paid parts of the game are very expensive and almost entirely needed to enjoy the game without hustle and stress. What a shame!

The scrolling-shooter mechanic, while as-advertised, is quickly replaced by a PvP city building upgrade-based pay-to-win system. It's padded out with just enough mechanics from a bunch of different games to make it a little of what you want and too much of what you don't. If you're just here for the scrolling shooter, don't bother with this game. Too much effort for too little return.

It's okay at first but after playing for a while you have to do a week or more of collecting resources, building, and levelling up just to get a few minutes of shoot em up action. Don't download unless you specifically want a city-building game. It's very irritating that all these run and gun shoot 'em up games transition into city-building games. Seems like it's the developer's strategy to get players to pay actual money to play.

This game is not what they advertised. I played for a week and the first thing is the amount of sexualized anime girls they put as main characters. Pay to win, and pay to play... you can play for free but in some point the game kinda tells you to buy characters or to progress in the game. There's a lot of activities but everything is around hours of waiting to construct a city and the game is not totally based on what they say on ads.

Firstly, THE AD IS A LIE!!! DONT BELIEVE IT!!! Secondly, It's a really amazing war game, I would recommend it to anyone who dares to go up against hundreds of active players at a time for the win! To the Last Z team: there are a few things that we can discuss to iron out the gameplay for other players, it would be greatly appreciated!! ~HunnyDrew :)

Great game. Not as advertised. This is an online multiplayer game. This is one of those games often described as pay to win. Quite a few bugs in the game, so of which the developers have addressed, many they haven't. A common complaint in the chat rooms of the game is that there is no response from support. I logged several issues with support and did not receive a response at all.

a base building cash grab game where staying relevant requires absurd amount of money. It's literally about who has the biggest wallet. There is not much skills required and the gameplay gets extremely boring and repetitive, you just have to invest more and more the longer you play since the game continually gives you less and less resources and build time keeps increasing exponentially. Avoid at all costs.

Lies. Played Last War for over a year, not really knowing why I stuck it out that long, having been initially led there from their ads which suggested it would be a shooter game when in reality the interaction with the game mode they show in the ads is very limited. Saw the ads for this game which actually mock other similar games that use this tactic, promising Last Z is different (it isn't) - and to make it even more shameless, this has the name 'shooter' in the title. Should have guessed...

Fun elements to the game, like the main combat, and the special ops. These bits look like what you see in the Ads, however... they always add this rubbish/constructive base building gameplay in it. it's not particularly fun, and it stops you from playing the actual fun but. 'Want to keep battling? Not untill your base reaches level 10!, and to do that you'll need to upgrade other buildings first!' 😖 ruins the gameplay.

Game is a clear ripoff of "Last War" right down to the base layout to the kind of heros you recruit. What's worse is these so called devs are even more greedy. I miss the good old days when the playstore wasn't filled with cheap ripoffs and actually had decent games. This is not one of them. Avoid this game, there are better games to waste time and money on. I won't be devoting time to find out, but I also heard end game content is locked behind a paywall. So ya. Avoid this.

Dubious game that tries to lure you from the ads. When you actually play it you will see it's another base building game that gets grindy over time. Although it's little fun in the beginning the fun wears out when you have to constantly make purchases to keep going. You will end up spending so much money like me and still not be able to fully upgrade your characters. Just endless grind.

The start of the game wasn't bad clearing levels and completing blocks (free to play). Then it turns into a pay to play city builder. No way to succeed without paying regularly, can join alliance for some help then they add allies who are for some reason able to attack until you loose everything then you are forced to pay $$$ or never catch back up.

Complete scam. You don't get to kill zombies. Your city will be built after 2/3 days of game. End of the fun. If you want to go further, you need to spend so much $$$$ in one of the soooo many paying content and packages to not get frustrated by the slowness or repetitiveness of this game, or bullied by the players who throw their money through the windows. This kind of game should be banned from the store to prevent any player from getting scammed. This app should be reported.

So this game plays like the ads. But what I found a bit jarring is the emphasis on the "hot" AI female characters. A lot of zooming and lingering on them in suggestive ways. But more than that my biggest issue is that there is no challenge at all. You just go through it without any thought. So I'm giving it 3 stars because it barely feels like a game but is truthful to the ads.

The screenshots are not what the game looks like. It's mostly a city building game where you end up being constantly attacked by more powerful players that have spent a lot of money to get that powerful because it's pay to win. As someone who got up to 50+ days straight off playing, you end up getting to a point where they want you to spend AU$30+ to progress. The prices in their store have fake discounts which is illegal here in Australia too.

I purchased the Thanksgiving package during the event and never received anything I paid for. This package wasn’t just a simple bundle — it included access to discounted items in the Thanksgiving shop *and* it should have awarded points and rewards for multiple overlapping events happening at the same time. Because the game failed to deliver my purchase on time, I lost all of those benefits and opportunities. Despite paying in advance and waiting for three days, my account still shows nothing.

Very disappointed. The game in the ads is a very small part of the actual game. I actually enjoyed the season 1 game play enough that I spent on some of the available upgrades to continue playing. Then along came season 2. The whole basis of the game has changed to virus infected resource tiles and starting from scratch in a different game world. It is confused and the amount of money needed to be spent is ridiculous. Needless to say they have lost me and many other players. Total Rip off. Fail

Firstly If you're here because of the ads, don’t bother — it’s nothing like them. It’s actually a base-building game. Second it's completely pay-to-win. All the good stuff heroes/ upgrades is locked behind an expensive paywalls. You could buy a decent PC game on steam for that price. There is no reward for playing it without spending money & when big spenders with daddies money attack you, there's nothing you can do but sit there and watch your base burn. U will be "The guy on the chair".

It's better than others in this genre in terms of longevity, but like them, it quickly shifts away from the gameplay that drew you in. It turns into a resource-gathering grind, pushing you toward spending money. There needs to be a better balance I don’t mind spending a few pounds now and then, but not on a game that takes the fun out of it

This game is like ad shows for the first few levels. Then it completely shifts from ads to war game. Game was interesting to play till I reached Headquarters level 14. After then game becomes extremely slow. It takes more than 12 hours to upgrade structures. If you play for 40 minutes continuously, you will have nothing to do then. You will just have to stare at the screen and look at the long-lasting countdown. Preety fun at begining but quickly becomes boring. Not even ideal for paying player

This game's lame, too many limitations to progress, there no doubt to try and force you to waste money on it. Decided to uninstall. Also noted bug, got stuck in some alliance messaging system, the arrow to exit was right over a tab, and wouldn't activate - this needs addressing guys. Had to exit the game entirely. That was the last straw for me. Can't help but feel these games are a major cash cow verses gaming on something like an Xbox or PC.

This is the first game that has allowed racism, hate speech, and irl threats. Reporting doesn't work. Devs allow this behavior to go on in their games. Other than that the game is fine. Once you get to lvl 20, It starts to become pay to win. From level 29 to max level 30, you can expect to pay out money for a new car irl. There isn't enough resources in the game for the later levels, so you're forced to pay, loot others, or wait months. Also there's lots of drama in game, be prepared.

Don't believe the ads.. So if you came looking for the game in the ads you are going to be disappointed. It does kind of feature but not in the way you want. If you've played any other town builder games etc this is basically what it is and the main conquest missions feature that mode BUT it's not as the ads show it to be. You can go through labels but they don't have any impact or change the outcome of the fight, it's all about the hero power as is raid, clash etc. Don't waste your time.

I saw adverts on Facebook saying they were sorry the game didn't match the adverts, but this game does, so I installed this... Yes, you get the shooting action shown by the ads but the VAST majority of the game is building and upgrading your base. You CANNOT upgrade the heroes who do the shooting parts without upgrading your HQ. You CANNOT beat certain levels until you upgrade your heroes. See the problem? It's utter tedium for the most part.

Good Fun But Gave Up After Persistent Attacks. Can enjoy this game without spending as you can exit game and your buildings will still "grow" whilst offline. Good graphics and detail. However, gave up after an Alliance decided to keep attacking me and regularly setting me back a long way. I know it's a feature of the game but as I couldn't progress, Ilost interest. Yes, you can buy a defence against that, but I was not up for that. A manual online would also help to explain some details.

Same publishers as Dark War Survival and, look at that, their marketing is also deceptive and spams annoying ads at me. It's not nearly as bad but what looks like a fun little RPG/Shoot em up with multiple modes is just another boring survival game grind that occasionally become a shmup. The actual shooting stages have no tactical depth whatsoever, I've beaten stages by just moving left and right randomly and by standing on one side the whole time. Terrible. Just play R-Type or something

MISLEADING ADVERTISING, as it is not the advertised shooter, but a strategy game, which is probably not even bad. On closer inspection, you can see that such a simple shooter does not justify a size of over one GB. The actual game seems interesting, as I said, but it was not at all self-explanatory to me, i.e. I can't really judge it because I'm probably too stupid for it. 😜

This game sucks, listen: 1. This isn't what the ads promised at all. Far from a normal zombie shooter with a simple swipe UI, it's actually a 4X game like Rise of Kingdoms. 2. The game uses sexualized content to attract potential players, making it unsuitable for public play or for minors. 3. This game is heavily "pay-to-play." Much of its content is restricted and requires real money. For example, you cannot upload a profile picture or write a bio unless you pay for Pro privilege.

The game is alright, if you're looking to pass the time when waiting or bored. But it's not enough of you to pay for a better play experience. It's better to have less clicking. I like the option to sell or select items for trade amongst allied players of the same clan or class if possible.

This game is fun... but until someone powerful enemy (Alliance, multiple). comes and loot your resources. There should be some balancing features. Otherwise it'll be difficult to upgrade... if your answer is to purchase things from the market it's not possible for a normal gamer. They can purchase now and then but not all the time. bring in an auto shield or something that can balance these things out.

I have never played a game with so many issues in the software and gameplay. You try and progress you get stopped. You try to gather supplies and you are prevented so your shelter gets plundered multiple times. All you get is an unknown error message. The extra problem so many players are experiencing is the server maintenance update. Why are we not getting advanced notifications of the schedule of this routine. Because of this failure to inform players it is costing us all rewards.

Absolute SCAM! The pay to win packages and price ranges are ridiculous, multiple Monthly subscriptions that provide ridiculous advantages over free players and paying players not willing to pay the $60+ in Monthly subscriptions. I have played multiple "Pay to Win" Strategy Games, and this one has the "Pay Wall" come up later in the game compared to others, but the "Pay Wall" is ridiculously high. The combat, all game mechanics and even the store are just the same as other "Last..." War Games.

The new update made Katarina absolutely useless. What a waste of time and money but thats what this game is all about they pull you in making you think its all about shooting zombies next thing your waiting for days on end for buildings, research, troops and many other things to be upgraded especially if your not will to splash hundreds and in some cases thousands of dollars for upgrades, glad i only spent like 5bux if you're looking to just shoot zombies and nothing else, this is not the game!!

Confusing at times but nice game overall. I hope it will add more freebies. Get creative in adding new challenge. Season 2 is a mess., I might quit the game. My eyes hurt looking for cacti/sapphire. Incorporate electricity in the games like using it in trucks instead of Fuel. Also, heroes power keep fluctuating. Too many bugs costing our Alliance higher season 2 rewards. The developer never addressed our concern and continued distributing lesser rewards. I'm changing my rating from 3 to 1.

joined it thinking it was a zombie slayer game but then stuck with it through months of Basebuilding. the costs to do anything in this game are exorbantly high. $70 for one piece of "orange" hero equipment for example. if you want to be a top player be prepared to spend $100s if not $1000s of dollars on this game I spent about $75 and could not compete with many other players its a rip off for rich boys to play and when I brought my concerns to customer service they brushed me off.

amazing game. 3 months of playing this. but there's something I want to say. the price of their packages was so high grade and expensive. but we can play this game without spending money, just use your strategy. so much game update, almost everyday but can't fix the lag issue. I hope the developers can read this review. thank you and have a good day.

I played for a week, purchased a few heroes and items, logged in with my Gmail. Suddenly, it showed me — Connection error. Please try again. C000-6 I am unable to enter the game. I have cleared the cache and reinstalled the game, but the issue persists. I have tried contacting customer support, but with no luck; they never responded. It was the worst experience ever.

Borderline lie, the game does have the shooter minigame and you can play it, but it becomes irelevant to the main gameplay pretty fast. The game itself is another typical clan war game where you either spend or lose,though praise where it's due it gives you just enough handouts to keep the illusion that you have a chance against the guy that bought this or that 10$ pack, and I'm not even kidding the power here raises from anything but the minigame that was it's marketing feature.

Game is cool but customer service doesn't exist. If you have a problem with bought package, doesn't expect anyone will respond. Just sit in corner and cry. Also my friends account was stolen and no one respond to him too. He reached out via in-game help center and via support email - no response after week. In this game it's not possible to change a way of logging in, there's no way to change password or at least an option like "log out from all devices " or any way to retrieve your account

Essentially got scammed out of a limited edition skin after spending considerable money. This was due to incorrect instructions written for the event. I contacted customer support two times and the first time they pretended to respond then ghosted me, the second time they just ignored me. I would not recommend spending money in their limited time events until this is resolved. It is disappointing as I used to really enjoy the game.

The game isn't clickbait as I expected but it's just so boring. There's so much and so little going on at the same time. There's too many "storylines" going on at the same time. The actual game play that you see in the ads is really boring and then sometimes you get stuck having to wait hours to play that part because you have to upgrade a lot of things before you can play. Don't waste your timem

Great at start, even if the game wasn't like the ad, but as you progress (got up till HQ18) it becomes almost impossible to upgrade unless you are a p2w player. The upgrades becomes expensive but eveytime you gather resources, you get constantly attacked by stronger paying players and clans everytime. There's no recovery time, no limits on the no.of attacks on you, you just get stuck. It favors p2w players too much and if you are a casual player it's not worth playing at some point.

EDIT: devs removed indonesia language, even though there's a big Indo player base. It's a pay to win game, but you can have some fun as a free player, although obviously it's impossible to compete with p2w. If you're okay with spending some money, buying some of the S heroes with speedup skill is important to actually progress, and the earlier you buy the better (the later you get the less useful it becomes). It's also important if you're good with socializing and able to find a good alliance.

Never got past the first level. Art/style is different from the ad. The ad is the gameplay but it is a town building game as well with multiplayer elements. Lots of cleaveges for the pervs out there. Bugs during the intro: something pops up yet you are being directed to tap onto something and you can't since some banner popped up; I have to quit and restart the game to continue. It happened multiple times.

Graphics is good but the game isn't like the one shown on the game page. This is a pay to win game and the game pushes you to spend actual money by moving you to a stronghold territory. Progression is very hard and these kind of games are only good for people who first started to play as they will be in higher level. Also, there are no tutorial or explanation. Spend time on something else. I uninstalled it, feels like the best decision.

Updated review: after a couple of weeks of playing, the gameplay as shown in the ads is all but watered down into a few repetitive instances where the levels are basically the same. The game basically becomes a resource gathering loop where you are virtually forced to join an alliance and play with others online. Also the waiting times to gain levels and resources climb very quickly, making it very easy to fall into a pay to advance (not even win) scheme. Do not recommend.

Pay to win garbage. Played for a month but as always with this games you will never be good becuase every S hero is locked behind a 40$ price tag. Every golden equipment behind a 100$. As for the events? As free to play you will always fail to get top prizes. I will still play it, but if you want a fair game, this is not one of them. Also the main advertisement... The game mode is garbage is well. No thiught put into it and they repeat after just 10 levels.

I don't like portrait mode at all. The design is messy, with oversized buttons and distracting colors. The hero battles are too close and look overly zoomed in. The game feels unfinished – some features don’t work (like the “more” button for stats or changing the flag). Please add an option to choose between portrait and landscape, and improve the portrait design to make it cleaner and more consistent. landscape have more good design in cards, tables and others.

This game is addicting. No ads but in your face with top ups. Liked the portrait rewards and some features but landscape is much better in overall gaming experience. Portrait has limited view of world map. Can't foresee if someone's gonna attack. I wish they keep both versions. Still has lots of bugs; my alliance mates purchased top ups but didn't get the items they purchased. Support takes too long to respond. Lately, no reply at all

The game is fun and does add a little extra to increase base space, which gives a bit more to do outside of building and attacking. Like others in the genre it relies heavily on spending to be competitive. Sadly the pricing is extreme and the first 24 hours saw offers totalling over £1000 all of which combined would still not give you overall control. It is fun though, but pricing needs to be heavily adjusted and number of offers toned down.

It works. It is kind of boring, though... Probably because you have to work extra hard to play the actual game they promote in the ads. But it's ok for now and then. There is a learning curve as there are lots of things going on at the same time. I noticed no major bugs, just glitches from time to time. The graphics are nice. Could we at least get 1 free training ground a day with the real game to keep things engaging while waiting?

your ads are ridiculous 🙄 I truly hate them. Invest in better ads 👎 the dude in the karate suit is simply annoying && doesn't draw attention to the actual game.. I literally downloaded this game to say this won't even open the app I will uninstall... 0 effort on advertising means your game is a piece of 💩 👎👌

Reason for the 2-star review is because there's a lot here that I want to like but is bogged down by the Pay to win model. The first 1-2 hours are actually really fun. After that, you hit a wall with ridiculous upgrade timers, and the Pay to win aspects start to show. Unless you're a whale willing to fork out hundreds of dollars, please avoid this game. It's unfortunate because the foundation of the game is solid, and it has the potential to be something greater than what it is now. Cash grab
Good not but firing arms should be upgraded, and u hav gathered the powers in the stage they must be retained in the next stage tats why am given 4 star 🌟

Shamelessly forces players to spend money in the game. Unproportionally rewards players who spend tens of thousands of dollars. You do not have to be clever. Just spend the price of a car and you will be a demigod in this game. I do not recommend even installing it.
Very Acceptional nd easy to play. 🥰

During LVL 1 to 9 base, it's fun and all, but after I finish the quests, there's no other thing that keeps me interested. There should be events to keep the players entertained. Speedups and other packs are way too expensive but aren't really worth the prize. Now that I'm at LV 16, it's way too boring because the upgrades take a lot of time, and if you've got no speedups, you won't be able to catch up with other players. Also, monitor the language use of the players. It's vulgar and disgusting.
At first I thought it was just another zombie shooter, but it surprised me when I realized you need to grind and complete tasks to truly become strong. which is this game amazed me a lot

This game is highway larceny. The beginning is great it is just killing zombies. But then it throws you in a world of zombie hunters and survival of the apocalypse. The team that wins is the team that spends the most. Also an ugly twist the developers are in every game playing and managing the game guaranteeing unfair play. In the end I spent 2K USD on the game and they allowed my team and my people to be stolen by others. I reported it but they did nothing. I asked for a refund. We'll see.

This game is nothing like the ads you see. It's forcing you to buy all kinds of power ups or keep grinding. And the gameplay turns into elaborate alliance vs alliance and server vs server with repetitive tasks that again force you to spend money. It is not for a relaxed few minutes play. Also seems like a clone of dozens of other games, just a bit different graphics.

Customer service experience has been horrible. after spending money in this game I won't be spending any more because they don't want to hear about any bugs the game has. Unfortunately I can't recommend
completed 3 seasons and about to start the 4th. STOP ADDING STUPID ANNIMATIONS. NO ONE CARES. INCREASE GAMEPLAY. Customer service sucks. was fun. gets worse as the device get creative.

I actually liked the game but needed to delete my account. It's a 15 day wait to delete and you have to meet a number of requirements. Once you've waited and you've met all the requirements you can hit 'confirm deletion', however this button doesn't work. I have messaged support many times with only auto responses or a message trying to get me to stay playing. Super frustrating and don't trust anything that refuses to let you cancel your account. Definitely don't recommend this game.

As a game tester - scam. this game has nothing to do with the classic potal multiplier games. This game is just selling visuals of sexy female zombie fighters. this game follows a simple story with just one male character. I liked how they added the base building mechanics, but the zombie part isn't that good. overall experience - Try if you want to, otherwise, good to skip.

the game is fun untill you find a developer playing itself and bullying others just because they can get free packs. second thought os that the developers aren't putting a limit in purchase so the rich guys will always win just because they have more money. compared with Epstein I say they are doing it the same. no matter how you are trying to upgrade and spend a decent amount of money they will bring a stronger payers that has already t10 on when you have T9 maximum in the middle of season 1.
Can the devs please add the flag of Puerto Rico, we are after all part of the US!

I liked the music, nothing else. This is a grinding game. It takes a lot of time to build my town for F2P. Wait, I didn't sign up for that. It has fewer zombies combat and if I wanted more, I have to upgrade. Otherwise, I get defeated alot. I was randomly placed on a map and I have to pay to move nearer to my alliance. It lacks tutorial. This game encourages WAR over peace against other people and that's why I'm uninstalling this game.
Was fun now u have to buy gold bars to buy points double purchase i didn't think so at first but yep it's a money grab fun game jus wish it didn't cost so much or at least get more bang for your buck

little updates every single day are annoying. my net isn't amazing so It's a problem when it's daily. Game is way too Pay to win. some key features are behind paywalls making it literally impossible for free players to compete. The arcade style zombie fighting is fun but they put minimal effort into later rounds with the design being nearly identical each time. It's a base building game with army attacks more than it's a zombie shooter. I enjoy it, but because of all the deception, 1 star.

Game is good and I played it for a long time but the developers decided to introduce portrait mode (earlier players could choose between landscape or portrait) only which has taken away the whole gaming experience. Eyes hurt like hell since lots of icons and windows are crammed into a very small screen. Request the developers to let players chose for themselves rather than enforcing it upon them by showering fancy rewards. Lots of players are going to leave if they do not do something about it.

The game is not as advertised. 10% of it is what is advertised, the rest is a carbon copy war game like Lords Mobile. Would not recommend it to anyone that is just looking for a casual game. Stronger players who spend money bully you and steal everything you build. The game doesn't even offer shields for weaker players to protect themselves. And the shields on offer is so expensive no one can afford them. I'd give a zero rating if I could. Very disappointed.

Fun lasted first couple of hours, and then people started attacking your base and stealing your resources. You have to buy protection and may be resources and heroes and all progress. Just another money pit!!! Such a waste!! Although one thing was game had a section where you play what's shown in ads. But not a fun game...just some game you would stress over everyday about shield and attacks and a lot of people will spend money to loot you. Rich will always be stronger and free to play suffer.
moolah money sucker credible game on every junction & its monotonous ... bores your joy of playing anything in future.

Although there is some effort put in the game and for the hour I played was serviceable, even good but the negatives are like several elephants in a small room. The story is simplistic The gameplay is grindy and super repetitive. I short don't waste your time data and space

This is a great game! Downloaded this game after seeing it though an AD. A year later I didn't expect to still be playing! I've met So many Amazing people from all over the world. The people in this gaming community definitely keep the game interesting an Prolonging. Highly recommend you try it out!!!
A game for those that enjoy city building. Plenty of room for strategising as well as shooting up enemies in all shapes and sizes.
real good fun with no ads

it a fun game but it boils down to the same old build your base and get attacked most of these games do this.the bad part is now they want you to buy packs of gold bars to buy packs instead of just paying for it,no logical reason unless they are about to get shady

As other's have commented, this is just another city/base/castle building game, with some shooter gameplay to lure people in. It is almost a complete duplicate of Clash of King's, with the same type of buildings, events and rewards, except you have zombies substituted for knights.
